therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: BEAM chemotherapy + autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: high-dose immunoablation followed by immune reconstitution
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: immune system reset to eliminate autoreactive lymphocytes driving demyelination
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Event-free survival probability at 5 years post-transplant

results.target_engagement_evidence: Neutrophil engraftment mean 10.8 days; platelet engraftment mean 18.5 days, confirming successful hematopoietic reconstitution
biomarker_changes: Change from baseline in gadolinium-enhanced lesions: -2.1 at 8 weeks, -2.5 at 1-2 years, -2.7 at 5 years
Change from baseline in T2-weighted lesion volume: -0.8 mL at 8 weeks, -2.3 mL at 5 years
Change from baseline in EDSS: -0.3 at 6 months, -0.9 at 5 years (improvement)
Brain volume percent change from screening: -0.8% at 8 weeks, -2.3% at 5 years (ongoing atrophy)
New T2 lesions per scan remained near 0 throughout follow-up (0.1–0.4)
subgroup_findings: No treatment-related mortality at any timepoint
100% of participants experienced grade ≥3 adverse events over 6-year follow-up
95.8% experienced grade ≥3 adverse events within 12 months post-HCT
safety_signals: 100% of participants experienced CTCAE grade ≥3 adverse events over the study period
95.8% experienced grade ≥3 adverse events within 12 months post-HCT

Serious adverse events included lymphopenia (3/25), leukopenia (2/25), pyrexia (2/25), and individual cases of AV block, cardiorespiratory arrest, arteriovenous malformation, blurred vision, constipation, chest pain, and fatigue

dose_info.dose: BEAM: carmustine, etoposide, cytarabine, melphalan (standard BEAM doses not individually specified in record)
dose_info.schedule: G-CSF and prednisone at study entry for mobilization; BEAM conditioning ≥7 days after graft collection; autologous HCT after conditioning

adverse_events.term: All-cause morbidity within 12 months post-HCT (grade ≥3 CTCAE)

context.duration: 5-year follow-up post-transplant (up to 6 years from study entry)

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Prednisone co-administered with G-CSF during mobilization phase to enhance stem cell yield and reduce mobilization-related inflammation

modulation_entries.hypothesis: BEAM conditioning (carmustine as lead alkylating agent) ablates the autoreactive immune system, creating space for transplanted autologous progenitors to reconstitute a tolerogenic immune repertoire
